sections.title: Common Inquiries
sections.subtitle: Details regarding our medical treatments and patient process.

items.question: What should I expect during my initial consultation?
items.answer: We begin with a comprehensive facial assessment, discuss your specific aesthetic goals, and collaboratively build a customized treatment roadmap designed exclusively for your anatomy.

items.question: Is there significant downtime after injectable treatments?
items.answer: Most patients return to daily activities immediately. We utilize advanced techniques and provide detailed aftercare instructions to minimize any temporary swelling or bruising.

items.question: How do I know which laser treatment is appropriate for my skin type?
items.answer: Safety is our priority. Your practitioner will carefully evaluate your skin type, tone, and specific concerns during your visit to recommend the safest and most effective light or laser modality.

items.question: Do you offer ongoing skin maintenance plans?
items.answer: Yes, we curate seasonal aesthetic programs focused on consistent cellular turnover, collagen preservation, and maintaining the results of your clinical treatments at home.
